intro: Kosovo's culture combines Albanian, Serbian, Ottoman and other traditions.

chapters.title: Heritage
text: Medieval Serbian monasteries and Ottoman mosques and bridges, such as those in Prizren, show Kosovo's layered history. In Pristina, a big sculpture spelling 'NEWBORN' was unveiled on independence day and is repainted every year.

chapters.title: Food
text: Flija, a layered pancake baked slowly over hot coals, is a traditional dish.

keyTerms.meaning: Traditions, buildings and objects passed down from the past.
